name: Tabs
summary: Switch between panels of related content in one place, as line, pill or vertical tabs.
description:
Use tabs for views of the same thing that people compare or move between, such as Overview, Activity and Settings. For steps in a flow use steps; for page navigation use links.

The styling is done and follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern. Switching panels and arrow keys come with the tabs JS module; until then set aria-selected and hidden yourself.

classes.name: v-tabs
classes.description: The wrapper around the tab list and its panels.

classes.name: v-tablist
classes.description: The row of tabs, with role="tablist". Scrolls sideways when the tabs do not fit.

classes.name: v-tab
classes.description: One tab, a <button role="tab">. The selected one gets an accent underline.

classes.name: v-tabpanel
classes.description: A panel, with role="tabpanel". Hidden panels carry the hidden attribute.

classes.name: v-tabs-pill
classes.description: Tabs in a soft track with the selected one raised, like the segmented control.

classes.name: v-tabs-vertical
classes.description: Tabs beside the panel when the slot is at least 36rem wide, a row below that.

states.description: On the current tab: underlined, raised in the pill form.
On the other tabs, so Tab goes from the selected tab straight to its panel.
On every panel except the current one.
On a tab that cannot be chosen: dimmed.
On the tablist of vertical tabs, so arrow keys will move up and down.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the selected tab, then to its panel.

a11y: Arrow keys, Home and End are not built yet: the tabs JS module will add them, along with switching panels on click.
Give the tablist an aria-label, link each tab to its panel with aria-controls, and each panel back with aria-labelledby.
Panels have tabindex="0" so keyboard users can reach a panel that has no focusable content.
